description: 八字看健康的完整知识库
core_logic: 八字看健康以五行平衡、十神组合、枭神夺食、羊刃逢冲、官杀混杂为五个风险维度，五行对应脏腑，十神反映体质，特殊组合预示疾病或生死危险，大运流年引动应期。

five_elements_body.bad: 过旺则偏瘦；过弱则松散

ten_god_body.data_source: bazi_result.json → ten_gods[] (filter: name === '食神' AND is_wang === true)
bazi_result.json → ten_gods[] (filter: name === '正印' AND utility === '用')
bazi_result.json → ten_gods[] (filter: name in ['正财','偏财'] AND utility === '用')
bazi_result.json → ten_gods[] (filter: name === '偏印' AND is_wang === true) + 存在 ten_gods[] (filter: name === '食神' AND is_constrained === true)
bazi_result.json → ten_gods[] (filter: name === '伤官' AND is_wang === true)

section_2_life_death_assessment.title: 断生死铁口直断
section_2_life_death_assessment.warning: 单一断语不可定论，必须结合原局+大运+流年综合判断

core_combinations.data_source: bazi_result.json → ten_gods[] (filter: name === '偏印' AND is_wang === true AND utility === '忌') + ten_gods[] (filter: name === '食神')
bazi_result.json → dynamics.features[] (filter: contains '羊刃') AND pillars[].shen_sha (filter: contains '冲')
bazi_result.json → ten_gods[] (filter: name === '正官' AND is_wang === true) + ten_gods[] (filter: name === '七杀' AND is_wang === true)
bazi_result.json → ten_gods[] (filter: name in ['食神','伤官'] AND technical_metrics.is_sitting_on_tomb === true)

section_3_blood_light_injury.title: 血光/意外伤害
section_3_blood_light_injury.male_general_arrow: 酉戌辰时春不旺，未卯子时夏中亡，寅午丑时秋并忌，冬季亥申巳为殃

key_indicators.rule: 有箭有弓方为凶；有箭无弓不伤人
key_indicators.data_source: bazi_result.json → dynamics.features[] (filter: contains '煞' OR contains '刃')

key_indicators.rule: 有煞有冲为真煞，有煞无冲为假煞
key_indicators.data_source: bazi_result.json → pillars[].shen_sha[] (存在) + pillars[].shen_sha (filter: contains '冲' OR contains '击')
